svg.title: Spherical doubling: two sheets joined through radial necks
svg.desc: Original construction schematic informed by Kapouleas and McGrath. Full surface and cutaway show two spherical sheets connected through twenty radial necks on two aligned latitude circles. A local section explains the catenoidal connection. Model genus nineteen; no small-genus existence claim. Not a solved self-shrinker.

g.text: Two nearby spherical sheets, connected through radial catenoidal necks
Front half removed to expose the inner sheet
m = 10 sites per latitude · 20 bridges · model genus 2m − 1 = 19
Balanced linearized latitude guide; neck size and gap enlarged.
Existence requires sufficiently large m; the displayed values are illustrative.
The sheets join around an open throat.
CONSTRUCTION SCHEMATIC · not a solved self-shrinker · cut edges belong only to the display
